name: Benefits and Programs API (Historical)
description:
This dataset is a historical snapshot of New York City benefits and social service programs, with 5,000 sampled rows and 34 columns. Each row describes a program, service, benefit, or resource, including its name, acronym, plain-language name, category (such as education, cash and expenses, health, work, family services, and housing), and the government agency that runs it. It also records who the program serves, such as children, families, immigrants, veterans, or youth, along with age groups and population details.

Much of the content is written for the public. Program descriptions, brief excerpts, eligibility rules, and "heads up" notes are included, often as HTML-formatted text. The dataset covers how to apply through several channels: online, by mail, in person, and by phone, with call-to-action labels, application URLs, PDF form links, and office location links where available. It also includes help-seeking information, such as where to get assistance in person
